name: Prosciutto, Pear & Blue Cheese Sandwich with Spinach-Mushroom Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ kg white mushrooms
3 pears
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
Divide bread slices between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place each baking sheet in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice onion.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice pears.

Spread mayo and Dijon over half of the toasted bread slices. Layer a small handful of spinach, onion, pear, prosciutto, and blue cheese over top (reserving remaining spinach for the salad). Close with remaining toast slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
24 slices prosciutto
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add remaining spinach to the bowl with the dressing and mushrooms; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
